clips.title: The story
paras: In Ashenvale, Sentinel Thenysil sends travelers south to check on Kaela Shadowspear. The scout went into Stonetalon to watch Venture Company incursions with a gnome mage, but word from her has fallen silent.

In Astranaar, Sentinel Thenysil watches for threats pressing toward the ancient forest. Her friend Kaela Shadowspear went into the Stonetalon Mountains at Sentinel Wolfrunner’s order, to survey turmoil in the heights. Thenysil asks passing Alliance champions to find Kaela; no word has come, and she fears for her friend’s safety.

Kaela’s companion is a gnome mage assigned by Alliance leaders. The night elves joined the Grand Alliance for strategic reasons, but many Sentinels distrust arcane practitioners and gnome tinkers in the wilderness. Kaela keeps an outpost on the bluffs above Windshear Crag, where she watches the Venture Company’s widespread devastation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You seem to be full of wanderlust by the looks of you. Have you been to the Stonetalon Mountains? It is a land plagued by the Venture Co. And other enemies of the night elves.

Recently, Sentinel Wolfrunner sent my friend Kaela Shadowspear there to investigate what's happening to the land, but I have yet to hear word back from her. I'm even more concerned because the Alliance sent a gnome mage along with her... A sign of trouble for sure.
Would you find her and report back to me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you've come from Ashenvale at the behest of Tara--how I miss her, my homeland and friends. She must be doing well with the Sentinels to be sequestering adventurers for other tasks. I'm proud of her.
It is a pleasure to meet you, friend.
